verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Serious Bomb as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 500 Ki, with pseudo-strike, projectile, ball, long-range, multi-hit, and knockback characteristics.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists the TP Medal Shop as the acquisition route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the skill is documented as a TP Medal Shop acquisition and no qualifying Ultimate Finish evidence is applicable.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Serious Bomb is kept distinct from Remote Serious Bomb and DUAL Remote Serious Bomb.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage and hit totals are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.
